item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 07/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The monsoon depression near Beibu Wan will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to western Guangdong tomorrow. A trough of low pressure is expected to form over the northern part of southern China and move southwards gradually, bringing showers to the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days. It will then turn northwards and move across the western North Pacific.
